step.name: defineCcacspServer
step.title: Create a CC ACSP server
step.description: Create the CC ACSP server with all required resources

step.name: createDirectories
step.title: Create and mount directories
step.description: Create the directories required by the new server

step.name: createZFS
step.title: Create zFS datasets
step.description: If requested, create and mount a new ZFS

step.name: MountZFS
step.title: Mount zFS filesystem
step.description: This step runs a script to mount the zFS dataset within the directory specified by the templates SERVER_USER_DIR property. The job is run under the userid specified by the templates UKO_ADMIN_ZFS property.
step.instructions: Execute the mount zFS script to mount the zFS dataset (MountZFS.sh)

step.name: populateServerUserDir
step.title: Populate server user directory
step.description: Populate the directory for the server

step.name: linkFilesAndFolders
step.title: Link installation files and folders
step.description: Link to the installation folders and the correct versions of the JCCA libraries. You need to chose the correct jcca libraries according to your ICSF release
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}
echo "creating new bin folder" mkdir bin echo "Changing ownership of the bin folder to the server user and group" chown ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} bin
cd bin
echo "creating symbolic links" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/bin/libjcca-${instance-ICSF_RELEASE}.so.1.6.8.5 libjcca.so ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/bin/lib${instance-ICSF_RELEASE}.so lib${instance-ICSF_RELEASE}.so ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/bin/libacspzsec6.so libacspzsec6.so
echo "symbolic links created, result:" ls -al
echo "Linking to the lib and libmon installation folders" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/lib ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/lib ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/libmon ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/libmon

step.name: createServerConfig
step.title: Create the server config
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
echo "Creating the config directory" mkdir ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config
echo "Copying log4j2.properties" cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/config/log4j2.properties ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config/log4j2.properties
sedstring="" # remove unused entries #port.tcp-dir.9997 = tcp:acp,cca,ccc #port.tls-dir.9994 = tls:acp,cca,ccc #sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*port.tcp-dir.9997.*##g;" #sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*port.tls-dir.9994.*##g;"
# remove unused services #service.all = tcp-dir,tls-dir,tcp-all,tls-all sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*service.all.*#service.all = tcp-all,tls-all#g;"
#if(${instance-SERVER_PORT_NOTLS} && ${instance-SERVER_PORT_NOTLS} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*port.tcp-all.*#port.tcp-all.${instance-SERVER_PORT_NOTLS}=tcp:acp,cca,ccc#g;" #end #if(${instance-SERVER_PORT_TLS} && ${instance-SERVER_PORT_TLS} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*port.tls-all.*#port.tls-all.${instance-SERVER_PORT_TLS}=tls:acp,cca,ccc#g;" #end
#monitor.agent.port=9050 #if(${instance-CONFIGURATION_PORT} && ${instance-CONFIGURATION_PORT} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*monitor.agent.port=.*#monitor.agent.port=${instance-CONFIGURATION_PORT}#g;" #end
# select jCCA JNI Library to use # hsm.cca.jccalib=HCR77D2 #if(${instance-ICSF_RELEASE} && ${instance-ICSF_RELEASE} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*hsm.cca.jccalib=.*#hsm.cca.jccalib=${instance-ICSF_RELEASE}#g;" #end
# ssl.keyring.name=ACSP-IVP-KEYRING sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keyring.name=.*#ssl.keyring.name=${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_KEY_RING}#g;" # setting the key ring user name #if(${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_OWNER} && ${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_OWNER} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keyring.user=.*#ssl.keyring.user=${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_OWNER}#g;" #else sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keyring.user=.*#ssl.keyring.user=${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}#g;" #end
#server.persistent.data.path = /var/acsp sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*server.persistent.data.path.*#server.persistent.data.path=${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*log4j2.configuration=.*#log4j2.configuration=${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config/log4j2.properties#g;"
# define application id for ACSP, default is ACSPPROD sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*auth.map.applid=.*#auth.map.applid=${instance-SAF_PROFILE_PREFIX}#g;" #if(${instance-ACSP_AUTH_MAP_SVC} && ${instance-ACSP_AUTH_MAP_SVC} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*auth.map.svc=.*#auth.map.svc=${instance-ACSP_AUTH_MAP_SVC}#g;" #end
# set the default instance to JCECCARACFKS sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keystore.instance=.*#ssl.keystore.instance=JCECCARACFKS#g;" # keep the original hardware provider for now sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keystore.provider=.*#ssl.keystore.provider=com.ibm.crypto.hdwrCCA.provider.IBMJCECCA,2#g" # !!! remember to remove the last semicolon
echo "Copying acsp.server.properties and replacing values" sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/config/acsp.server.properties > ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config/acsp.server.properties;
echo "Changing ownership of the server config directory and its content" chown -R ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config

step.name: createClientConfig
step.title: (Optional) Create test client config
step.description: Create the server configuration file and folder in case you used the sample flow to create the certificate client keystore and truststore
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
echo "copying jcca.client.properties files" cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/config/jcca.client.properties ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config/jcca.client.properties
cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config
sedstring=""
sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*client.connect.host=.*#client.connect.host=localhost:${instance-SERVER_PORT_TLS}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keyStorePassword=.*#ssl.keyStorePassword=${instance-EXPORT_PASSWORD}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.trustStorePassword=.*#ssl.trustStorePassword=${instance-EXPORT_PASSWORD}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.trustStore=.*#ssl.trustStore=${instance-EXPORT_PATH}/${instance-CERT_CLIENT_USER}-truststore.p12#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*ssl.keyStore=.*#ssl.keyStore=${instance-EXPORT_PATH}/${instance-CERT_CLIENT_USER}-keystore.p12#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*client.transport=.*#client.transport=tls#g" # !!! remember to remove the last semicolon
echo "replacing parameters in acsp.scripts.properties" sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/config/acsp.scripts.properties > acsp.scripts.properties # add trust store password manually until present in script echo "ssl.trustStorePassword=${instance-EXPORT_PASSWORD}" >> acsp.scripts.properties
echo "making the bin folder readable and executable so the client can use the jcca libraries" chmod 755 ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/bin
echo "Copying test scripts" cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/allverbs ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/allverbs cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/loadtest ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/loadtest cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/sunshinetest ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/sunshinetest cp ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/threadtest ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/threadtest
echo "Changing ownership of the test scripts" chown ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/*test chown ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/allverbs

step.name: createParmlib
step.title: Create Parmlib member
step.description: Create the parmlib member for the server

step.name: substituteParmlib
step.title: Substitute Parmlib values
step.description: Replace values in the Parmlib members with the values from the properties file
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
# original provisioning for ACSP as a service # cat "//'DPBUILD.SMP.HAZH230.CNTL(PRMSET)'" "//'DPBUILD.SMP.HAZH230.CNTL(PRMJAV)'" "//'DPBUILD.SMP.HAZH230.CNTL(PRMSRV)'" > ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-PARMTEMP cp "//'${instance-CC_SAMPLIB}(KMGZPARM)'" ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-PARMTEMP
sedstring="" # ACSP Server home directory sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*export ACSP_HOME=.*#export ACSP_HOME=${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}#g;"
# ACSP Optional configuration directory - defaults to $ACSP_HOME/config sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*export ACSP_CONFIG=.*#export ACSP_CONFIG=${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/config#g;"
# ACSP Optional configuration file - defaults to 'acsp.server.properties' sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*export ACSP_PROP=.*#export ACSP_PROP=acsp.server.properties#g;"
# setting the java home path sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*export JAVA_HOME=.*#export JAVA_HOME=${instance-JAVA_HOME}#g"
sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-PARMTEMP > ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-ACSPPARM rm ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-PARMTEMP
